questions.question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

Pay attention to what's happening and make ______ adjustments based on your personal experience.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"reasonable."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Reasonable" **means fair, practical and sensible. (उचित व्‍यवहार और विवेकपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: *I think it’s **reasonable**__ to expect people to keep their promises.*
 
 
 
• **"Make reasonable adjustments"** means to make changes that are sensible and logical. (ऐसे परिवर्तन करना जो समझदार और तार्किक हों)
 
• It is important to pay attention to what is happening and adjust accordingly based on personal experience.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Pay attention to what's happening and make __**reasonable**__ adjustments based on your personal experience.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Impartial**: Not favouring one side over another. (जिसमें दो पक्षों में से किसी एक को अधिक प्रमुखता न दी जाए; निष्‍पक्ष)

 
 
• **Example**: *The judge was **impartial**__ in the court case.*
 
 
 
• **Honest**: Telling the truth and not lying. ((व्‍यक्ति) सत्‍याचरण करने वाला, ईमानदार; चोरी आदि असत्‍याचरण न करने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *It is important to be **honest**__ in all aspects of life.*
 
 
 
• **Placid**: Calm and peaceful. ((व्‍यक्ति या पशु) शांत और जल्‍दी उत्तेजित न होने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**:* The lake was **placid**__ and serene in the morning light.*
